definitions.gloss: company cafeteria; staff canteen; office cafeteria
definitions.explanation: An in-house dining facility at a company, where employees can buy meals at subsidized prices. Used both for the cafeteria itself and for the meals served there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社食|しゃしょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I eat lunch at the company cafeteria.

examples.japanese: {社食|しゃしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The cafeteria menu changes every day.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{社食|しゃしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦ほぼ→ほぼ：00109_hobo⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{利用|りよう}している→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: Our company cafeteria is cheap and nutritionally balanced, so I use it almost every day.

notes:
Casual abbreviation of ⟦{社員|しゃいん}{食堂|しょくどう}→社員食堂：19803_shainshokudou⟧ (employee cafeteria). Common in spoken language and informal writing; the full form is preferred in formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社食|しゃしょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat at the company cafeteria
- {社食|しゃしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧: cafeteria set meal
- {社食|しゃしょく}⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧: cafeteria meal ticket

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{社員|しゃいん}{食堂|しょくどう}→社員食堂：19803_shainshokudou⟧: employee cafeteria (full form)
- ⟦{学食|がくしょく}→学食：12241_gakushoku⟧: university cafeteria (same abbreviation pattern)
- ⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧: cafeteria; canteen (general term)
